Inside lay a dry sheet. “The light at Grey Rock has gone out,” it read. “Come before the next moon, or we are lost.” Elias looked north, where Grey Rock rose beyond forty miles of rough water. Its beacon had been dark for thirty years, since the wreck that took his father. He could have dismissed the message as a cruel trick. Whatever hand had written those words, someone was waiting in the dark, and no keeper worth his salt could leave them there.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一艘暂泊的船。高架桥上只剩零星的灯，出租车拖着湿漉漉的光穿过路口。便利店的白光照着困倦的店员，也照着门口一只躲雨的猫。远处工地的塔吊沉默地指向天际，早点铺却已升起第一缕白汽。风从空荡的街角吹来，带着潮气和昨夜未散的音乐。此刻，大多数梦还没有靠岸，而清洁车的水声，正轻轻擦亮黎明。","w03":"- Recursion is when a way of solving a problem uses a smaller version of the same problem.\n- Imagine opening a box, finding a smaller box, and repeating until you reach the tiniest one.\n- The tiniest box is the stopping point; then you work back out, closing each box in turn."}
